senses.gloss: स्नान-द्रोणी स्नान-द्रोणी, f. a bathing-tub, Rājat. 5, 46.
स्नान- + वस्त्र स्नान- + वस्त्र, n. a bathing cloth, Hit. ii. d. 102.
स्नान- + शील स्नान- + शील, adj. bathing, observing ablations, Hit. 18, 7, M.M.

श्नथ् श्नथ्, i. 1, Par. To hurt, to kill, to destroy.
 --Cf. Goth. snithan; A.S. snidhan.

स्नपन स्नपन, i. e. स्ना, Caus., + अन, n.
 1. Washing.
 2. Bathing, ablution, Śiś. 8, 70.
स्नापन स्नापन, i. e. स्ना, Caus., + अन, Bathing, Man. 2, 209.
स्नव स्नव, i. e. स्नु + अ, m. Oozing, dripping.

स्नाव स्नाव, m. A tendon, a muscle.
 --Cf. probably O.H.G. senwa; A.S. sinu, sinw, senw.

† स्नस् स्नस्, i. 1 and 4, Par.
 1. To eject.
 2. To eat (?).

स्नसा स्नसा, f. A tendon, a muscle.
 --Cf. perhaps O.H.G. snôr, snuor, see स्नाव.

स्ना स्ना, ii. 2, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., MBh. 3, 7072),
 1. To bathe, Man. 4, 82; anomal. potent. स्नायीत, MBh. 3, 7072.
 2. To perform the ceremony of bathing when leaving the house of one's spiritual preceptor, Man. 2, 245. स्नात,
 1. Bathed, having bathed, Rājat. 5, 391; Daśak. in Chr. 188, 20.
 2. Purified, Mahāv. 77, 2; pure. m. (One whose spiritual instruction is finished, [] see
 2.), an initiated householder.
 --Comp.
 --Caus. स्ना̆पय,
 1. To wash, to cleanse, Daśak. in Chr. 200, 7 (आ); Megh. 44 (ă).
 2. To weep for (?), Utt. Rāmac. 69, 1 (ă). स्नपित,
 1. Bathed, Mālat. 60, 10.
 2. Moistened, Kir. 5, 44; 47.
 --With अप अप, अपस्नात, Bathed after mourning, Rām. 2, 42, 22.
 --With नि नि, निष्णात,
 1. Perfect, superior.
 2. Learned, MBh. 1, 3988; skilful, conversant, Śāk. 65, 18.
 3. Given to, Mālat. 37, 3.
 4. (In law), Agreed upon, Mālat. 174, 13. अति-निष्णात, Very conversant, Daśak. in Chr. 190, 19.
 --With प्रति प्रति,
 1. प्रतिस्नात, Bathed.
 2. प्रतिष्णात, Pure.
 --Comp.
 सु-प्रतिष्णात, adj. certain.
 --Cf. ναρός, νᾶμα, νοτίς, νῆσος, νίπτω; Lat. nare; Goth. nadr; A.S. naeddre, nedre; O.H.G. nacho; see नौ.

स्नातक स्नात + क (vb. स्ना), m. A Brāhmaṇa just returned from the mansion of his preceptor, Man. 2, 138 (cf. स्ना); an initiated householder, Lass. 71, 1; a Brāhmaṇa in his second आश्रम (order of life), Man. 1, 113; Hit. 123, 19.
 --Comp.

स्नान स्नान, i. e. स्ना + अन, n.
 1. Bathing, Pañc. 100, 8.
 2. Purification by bathing, Man. 1, 111; Pañc. iii. d. 120.
 3. Anything used in it, as water, perfumed powder, etc., Ṛt. 1, 4; Megh. 34, Sch.
 --Comp.
स्नानीय स्नानीय, adj. Ablutionary, fit for bathing in, or to be used in bathing, Mālav. d. 87; Ragh. 16, 21.
स्नापक स्नापक, i. e. स्ना, Caus., + अक, m. A servant who supplies or applies bathing water, Rām. 2, 64, 12, Seramp.

स्नायिन् स्नायिन्, i. e. स्ना + इन्, adj., f. नी, Bathing, Man. 11, 214.
 --Comp.

स्नायु स्नायु (probably a form of स्नाव, for स्नाउ), f.
 1. A tendon, Man. 8, 234; Pañc. 182, 17; a muscle, Bhartṛ. 2, 23.
 2. The string of a bow, Pañc. 121, 1.
स्नायुमय स्नायु + मय, adj., f. यी, Made of tendons, Pañc. 144, 14.
